notes: Sound clue cues of puzzle mechanisms (mw-e15.5): a clue node (src/sim/signals) sounds its cues in order, each as soundClueCued anchored at the node's bound spawn, so the chime is positional (behind a wall it is muffled and panned by the audio engine). Every clue cue is gameplay-critical: a player who cannot hear it still needs it, so each has a caption with a direction ([High chime, left]). All play the placeholder metal impact set until the approved bell and chime SFX arrive (mw-e38.144), which replaces the cue ids here and nothing else; the cue ids low, mid, high, wrong and solved are the contract with puzzle data.
